hook: prime-rl 0.11 can now pretrain, not just RL.

beats.say: The open-source reinforcement learning trainer prime-rl just shipped version 0.11.0, adding a new pretraining entrypoint.
It brings a major training performance boost, model-specific kernels, and bidirectional KV transfer for prefill and decode disaggregation.
There's also a pool of environment workers with far less CPU memory use, plus support for a batch of new models.
